subject.title: fix: avoid false stayed-stopped on launchd KeepAlive throttle

question: Should loaded macOS LaunchAgents keep a throttle-aligned stopped/free early exit near 20.5 seconds as proposed here, or should persistent supervision disable that early exit until the existing 60-second health deadline as proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109955?
rationale: Both patches solve the reproduced shipped bug and have positive real behavior proof, but they intentionally define different operator-visible failure latency and supervision contracts; repository evidence cannot choose that invariant safely without launchd-owner intent.

options.title: Use full bounded deadline
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109955 as canonical so any loaded KeepAlive recovery can use the existing 60-second budget, then close this competing PR.

options.title: Use throttle-aligned threshold
options.body: Land this PR and accept the approximately 20.5-second genuine-failure verdict as the supported balance between recovery tolerance and fast diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Use full bounded deadline
recommendation.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109955 as canonical so any loaded KeepAlive recovery can use the existing 60-second budget, then close this competing PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-based owner for the shared restart-health and update restart boundary where this timing policy is enforced.
